sentences.japanese: この１節を読み、日本語に翻訳せよ。
sentences.english: Read this passage and translate it into Japanese.

sentences.japanese: こちらへお出かけの節は是非お立ち寄りください。
sentences.english: If you happen to be out this way, be sure to call in at my house.

sentences.japanese: こちらにお出での節は、どうぞお立ち寄りください。
sentences.english: Please drop in when you come this way.

sentences.japanese: その節はよろしくご指導のほどお願いいたします。
sentences.english: I hope you will favor me with your guidance at that time.

sentences.japanese: その節はいろいろありがとうございました。
sentences.english: Thank you for all you did for me that time.
